method: Original UCLA university teaching pages opened directly with web tool for targeted chemistry; only paraphrased narrow supporting facts. Source-text reading plus independent actual valence/atom/charge audit, not blanket page/source approval.

sources.title: UCLA Illustrated Glossary: Arenium ion
sources.checkedFacts: Arenium ion is a carbocation formed on electrophilic attack on an aromatic ring and is an intermediate in electrophilic aromatic substitution. This supports class/model identification; exact candidate bond/charge placement was independently counted rather than inferred from author claims.

sources.title: UCLA Illustrated Glossary: Fehling's test
sources.checkedFacts: Positive test reduces Cu(II) and gives red copper(I) oxide precipitate. Terminal α-hydroxyketones can also respond positively, so generic ketone-negative inference is invalid. Candidate uses Ethanal/Propanon only; blue negative Propanon/brick-red Cu2O positive Ethanal comparison independently judged.

sources.title: UCLA Illustrated Glossary: Tollens' test
sources.checkedFacts: Colorless silver-ion reagent can be reduced to metallic silver, often a mirror, by aldehydes; terminal α-hydroxyketones can respond as well. Candidate positive Ethanal/negative simple Propanon cells and visible explicit example-only limit are consistent. No universal ketone class claim approved.

notChecked: No whole source-rights/full source-component/GUI-superset approval. No hazardous procedure or empirical classroom result certified.
